input.quote: 19.4 For breach of Section 19.1 or 19.2, Vendor shall promptly re-perform, repair, or replace the nonconforming item at no charge. If Vendor cannot do so within a reasonable period, Customer may terminate the affected item and receive a refund of Fees paid for it. This remedy is not exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security, or indemnified claims.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets the preferred position. 19.1 gives a professional and workmanlike services warranty plus a general conformity warranty; 19.2 gives a 90-day Deliverable conformity warranty and, better than preferred, conformity of Hosted Services throughout the subscription term (exceeding the 12-month software benchmark); 19.3 adds malicious-code and Applicable Law compliance warranties. 19.4 supplies the full remedy set (re-perform/repair/replace, then termination and refund of Fees paid) and expressly preserves other remedies for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The 19.5 disclaimer is mutual, limited to implied warranties, and expressly carved back so it cannot swallow the express warranties, service levels, indemnities or other remedies. Section 6.2 reinforces correction and refund rights on Deliverable rejection. No redline required.
